blocks.en: Expansion and Quality Improvement of Basic Education

blocks.zh: 保障普惠性学前教育资源有效供给。实现义务教育学校标准化建设全覆盖。以常住人口多的地区和人口流入地为重点，建设1000所以上优质普通高中。支持中学实验仪器设备提档升级，建设一批以高水平科学教育为特色的普通高中。
blocks.en: Effective supply of affordable preschool education resources will be ensured. Standardized development will be achieved in all compulsory education schools. Focusing on areas with large resident populations and areas with large inflows of people, more than 1,000 quality ordinary senior high schools will be built. Secondary schools will be supported in upgrading their laboratory instruments and equipment, and a number of ordinary senior high schools featuring high-level science education will be built.

blocks.zh: 优质高等教育资源扩容
blocks.en: Expansion of High-Quality Higher Education Resources

blocks.zh: 支持建设若干“双一流”高校新校区，“双一流”高校本科招生数增加10万人以上，建设200所左右高水平应用型本科高校、在有条件的高校建设若干优质特色学科专业。面向中西部、东北等地区布局建设高等研究院。实施国家基础研究创新提升工程，面向重点领域建设若干国家交叉学科中心和国家拔尖创新人才培养学院。依托国家卓越工程师学院建强一批工程师技术中心，建成150个左右国家产教融合创新平台。
blocks.en: Support will be given to building several new campuses of “Double First-Class” universities; undergraduate enrollment at “Double First-Class” universities will increase by more than 100,000; about 200 high-level application-oriented undergraduate universities will be built, and a number of high-quality distinctive disciplines and majors will be developed in qualified universities. Higher education research institutes will be established in the central and western regions, the northeast and other areas. The national basic research innovation and upgrading project will be implemented, and a number of national interdisciplinary centers and national top-notch innovative talent training colleges will be built in key fields. Relying on the National Excellent Engineer Colleges, a number of engineer technology centers will be strengthened, and about 150 national platforms for industry-education integration and innovation will be completed.

blocks.zh: 现代职业教育体系建设
blocks.en: Building a Modern Vocational Education System

blocks.zh: 建设60所左右高水平高等职业学校和160个左右高水平专业群，支持优质中等职业学校和专业建设。建设一批优质技师学院和100个优质专业。聚焦集成电路、人工智能、低空经济等重点产业和现代服务业，建设200个产教融合实训基地，支持一批高水平职业院校更新先进实训设备。
blocks.en: About 60 high-level higher vocational schools and about 160 high-level major clusters will be built, and quality secondary vocational schools and majors will be supported in their development. A number of quality technician colleges and 100 quality majors will be built. Focusing on key industries such as integrated circuits, artificial intelligence and the low-altitude economy as well as modern services, 200 industry-education integration practical training bases will be built, and a number of high-level vocational colleges will be supported in upgrading their advanced practical training equipment.
Shoring Up Weak Links in Special Education

blocks.zh: 推进特殊教育学校标准化建设，充分依托存量资源，支持有需求的县办好达到标准的特殊教育学校，支持人口规模大的城市建设孤独症儿童特殊教育学校，鼓励康教融合。将特殊教育纳入师范类学生必修课程。
blocks.en: Standardized development of special education schools will be advanced; with full reliance on existing resources, counties that have needs will be supported in running special education schools that meet standards; cities with large populations will be supported in building special education schools for children with autism; and the integration of rehabilitation and education will be encouraged. Special education will be included in the compulsory courses for students of teacher-training programs.
